sections.heading: For each distinct {{entity_noun}} you identify, this must hold:

rules.text: The phrase and its relationship summary support the manufacturer itself {{entity_relationships.gerund}} at least one item in the {{entity_noun}}, not merely relating to it.

children.text: The evidence may be a described activity, owned equipment, stated capacity, supplied offering, or product use.

sections.heading: The {{entity_noun}} you name must qualify, in BOTH of these ways:

rules.text: It is a determinate category: neither an individual item — a brand name, model number, part number, catalog code, or one-off description — nor a term so general it fixes nothing, such as "products", "parts", or "components". A phrase naming a specific item is reported as the category that item belongs to.

children.text: "Model 4200-B hydraulic manifold" is an individual item; the category it belongs to is "hydraulic manifold". Name the category, and never carry the brand, model, or part number into it.

rules.text: It is distinct from every other {{entity_noun}} named for the same phrase. Two names for the same {{entity_noun}} in different words are one, not two.

sections.heading: Name each {{entity_noun}} by the first of these rules that applies, in order:

rules.text: A {{entity_noun}} can be determined from the phrase and its relationship summary, and it is named directly.
No {{entity_noun}} can be determined from the phrase and its relationship summary, and "Cannot categorize" is named as the only entry for the phrase.
